body.title: Contract check and docs
body.summary: Complete tool-hooks.test.ts so every test the LLD acceptance mapping names exists (ac1 to ac5); confirm the read-only tool loop output and the 228-tool snapshot are unchanged; add the hook stage section to docs/daemon.md after the approval section.
acceptanceChecks: tool-hooks.test.ts holds a test with each title the LLD acceptance mapping names for ac1 to ac5
approval-class-mapping.test.ts and the read-only tool loop tests pass unchanged
docs/daemon.md describes the stage, the report, the canonical id rule, the per-hook copy and the missing cancellation bound

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/__tests__/tool-hooks.test.ts: a rule that throws a null-prototype object or a value with a throwing toString is reported with a fixed text
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/tool-hooks.test.ts: a rule that mutates nested result data leaves the caller's result untouched
src/agent/__tests__/read-only-tool-loop.test.ts: the read-only tool loop still returns the tool's output text unchanged when no rule is registered
